name: life_reach_days
label_en: delivery days in testing before a creative under the floor is parked
label_zh: 测试期的投放天数上限
explain: a week of delivery is long enough for a platform to show a creative to its people
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: life_learning_conversions
label_en: conversions before a creative is mature (the platform's learning flag wins when it gives one)
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: life_doubt_extension
label_en: the one extra look a doubt gets, in doubt_spend
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: life_learning_max_days
label_en: delivery days in learning before a slow creative goes to doubt
label_zh: 学习期的投放天数上限
explain: slow is not costly: it gets looked at
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: life_decline_rise
label_en: how far the 7-day cost per conversion may rise over its best before it counts as a decline sign
label_zh: 衰退:成本比最佳 7 天高出的比例
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: life_decline_drop
label_en: how far the 7-day spend may fall under its peak before it counts as a decline sign

why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: life_decline_days
label_en: days in a row of decline signs before a mature creative declines

why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: life_recover_days
label_en: days in a row without decline signs before a declining creative is mature again
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

label_en: the share of its peak under which a declining creative ends
label_zh: 衰退转结束的花费比例
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: life_end_idle_days
label_en: days without delivery after which a declining creative ends, or a switched-off creative that was never judged is parked
label_zh: 结束/停投未判的闲置天数

why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: life_park_review_days
label_en: days a parked creative waits before it is listed for a person to look at again
label_zh: 搁置多久后列出来复查
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: life_min_conversions_for_cost
label_en: conversions a 7-day window needs before a cost per conversion is read
label_zh: 7 天成本需要的最少转化
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client
